[[File:Droid_builder_award.png|thumb|250px|A blank Jawa droid builder certificate signed by Wimateeka]]
{{Quote|In recognition of your excellent droid building skills, we present to you this certificate aknowledging you as a Master Droid Builder.|Wimateeka to the Rebel agent|<ref name="Star Wars: DroidWorks">''[[Star Wars: DroidWorks]]''</ref>}}
A '''Jawa droid builder certificate''' was awarded by the diminutive [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to those who attained the rank of Master [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Droid builder/Legends|builder]] after training in one of their [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawlers]]. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an [[Unidentified Rebel agent (droid builder)|agent]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] was awarded such a certificate after successfully reprogramming a [[Unidentified Imperial assassin droid|new series]] of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]]. The agent's certificate was signed by [[Wimateeka]], the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] leader of the [[Nkik clan]].

==Behind the scenes==
Although signed by Wimateeka, the signature on the certificate awarded to the player in ''[[Star Wars: DroidWorks]]'' does in fact read "Wimattea" in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]].
